description: Hidrografia - Albufeiras, Lagos e Lagoas is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Câmara Municipal de Vale de Cambra. Hydrographic Network with the typology of Albufeiras, Lagos and Lagoas - from the Homologated Cartography 1:10.000, with Process n.º 683 of December 16, 2020. Coverage: Câmara Municipal de Vale de Cambra. The portal shows the English title as "Hydrography - Albufeiras, Lagos and Lagoas" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Câmara Municipal de Vale de Cambra. Its keywords include cartografia-tematica, lagoas, hidrografia, albufeiras, lagos. The listing shows 2 download or service links in KML, ZIP. The listing shows 2022-04-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
